dimensions.label: Terrain
dimensions.description: Slope distribution over ~25 km at the same pixel size (MOLA 463 m / LOLA 240 m vs Copernicus DEM)

dimensions.label: Rock type
dimensions.description: Rock class of the unit mapped at the site (Mars: USGS geologic map SIM 3292; Moon: highland crust) vs the global lithological map GLiM on Earth

dimensions.label: Water history
dimensions.description: Lake, delta and river deposits — no global data we could compare, so not scored

dimensions.label: Dryness
dimensions.description: Rainfall (GPM IMERG climatology 2000-2023) and bare ground (MODIS NDVI and land cover)

dimensions.label: Temperature
dimensions.description: Day-night surface temperature swing and cold (MODIS land surface temperature)

dimensions.label: Surface brightness
dimensions.description: Broadband albedo of the ground: MGS TES at the site vs MODIS (snow-free) on Earth. Dark rock and gravel match Mars' plains; bright sand and salt do not

dimensions.label: Thin air
dimensions.description: Elevation (Copernicus DEM): higher ground has thinner air and stronger UV. 5,000 m scores 100, and even there the air pressure is more than 80 times that on Mars

dimensions.label: Frozen ground
dimensions.description: Mean surface temperature below freezing (MODIS) as a permafrost proxy
